# Svg

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Draws an SVG document as vector content: paths, fills, strokes, gradients, clips and text drawn as glyph outlines, through the same canvas as every other element.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IAltTextProvider`, `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new Svg()
```

## Properties

- [`AltText`](#alttext): Alternate text for accessibility.
- [`FilePath`](#filepath): Path to an SVG file (mutually exclusive with `SvgData` and `SvgGenerator`).
- [`FitMode`](#fitmode): How the drawing fills its box, as for `Image`.
- [`Height`](#height): Desired display height in points (null = from the document).
- [`IsDecorative`](#isdecorative): When true, the drawing is decorative and tagged as an artifact, with no alt-text finding.
- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`.
- [`StrictUnsupportedFeatures`](#strictunsupportedfeatures): When true (the default), a document using a feature outside the supported profile fails generation, naming every such feature.
- [`SvgData`](#svgdata): SVG markup (mutually exclusive with `FilePath` and `SvgGenerator`).
- [`SvgGenerator`](#svggenerator): Produces the markup for the box it is given, in points (mutually exclusive with `SvgData` and `FilePath`).
- [`Width`](#width): Desired display width in points (null = from the document).

### `AltText`

```csharp
string AltText { get; set; }
```

Alternate text for accessibility. Under PDF/UA-1 it becomes the figure's `/Alt`. When not set, reads as the document's own `<title>`, which is used in its place.

### `FilePath`

```csharp
string FilePath { get; set; }
```

Path to an SVG file (mutually exclusive with `SvgData` and `SvgGenerator`).

### `FitMode`

```csharp
ImageFitMode FitMode { get; set; }
```

How the drawing fills its box, as for `Image`.

### `Height`

```csharp
float? Height { get; set; }
```

Desired display height in points (null = from the document).

### `IsDecorative`

```csharp
bool IsDecorative { get; set; }
```

When true, the drawing is decorative and tagged as an artifact, with no alt-text finding.

### `SemanticRole`

```csharp
SemanticRole SemanticRole { get; }
```

*read-only*

The structure role in a tagged PDF: `Figure` when the element has alternative text, otherwise `Artifact`. It is always `Artifact` when `IsDecorative` is set.

### `StrictUnsupportedFeatures`

```csharp
bool StrictUnsupportedFeatures { get; set; }
```

When true (the default), a document using a feature outside the supported profile fails generation, naming every such feature. When false, the rest is drawn and each skipped feature is a diagnostic - or, with `SvgRasterizer` set and an async generate path, drawn as an image in its place.

### `SvgData`

```csharp
string SvgData { get; set; }
```

SVG markup (mutually exclusive with `FilePath` and `SvgGenerator`).

### `SvgGenerator`

```csharp
Func<PdfSize, string> SvgGenerator { get; set; }
```

Produces the markup for the box it is given, in points (mutually exclusive with `SvgData` and `FilePath`). The box cannot come from markup that does not exist yet, so a generator needs both `Width` and `Height`.

### `Width`

```csharp
float? Width { get; set; }
```

Desired display width in points (null = from the document).
